caption:
The favorite book, read twice

A favorite book read twice is a different book. The second time through, the lines you skipped start to show.

Knowing how it ends is the reason to go back, because the second pass is slower and the ending doesn't change.

For whoever opens the same book again.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A bedroom with a thick blue book standing on the right. A plum block figure with narrowed eyes at the left says you know the ending. A ink-black block figure with white eyes answers again, the book opens and the pages turn one after another, and a star pops up above it. The plum one's eyes go wide and says I missed that line. Both end with happy eyes. The text stays: me, reading it again.
